title: lore agents --force runs the marketplace plugin update when installed and --target names the runtime (rulings 19, 21, 25, 26)
description: Routed by opum-agent OPAG-421. Binding record: opum-doc main 7831fff, docs/adr/distribute-lore-and-quest-agent-skills-through-the-plugin-marketplace.md (Amendments 1-4), rulings (b), (c), 19, 21, 25, 26(iii). Parity with quest-cli QCLI-371's 'quest agents --update-instructions' (opum-ai/quest-cli#266, 30a6846). When the plugin is installed AND the user named that runtime with --target, lore agents --force runs 'claude plugin update opum-lore@opum --scope <deciding scope>' or, for Codex (no per-plugin update), 'codex plugin marketplace upgrade opum' then 'codex plugin add opum-lore@opum', and says in its own output that the Codex upgrade refreshes every opum plugin (ruling 25). A bare call (no --target) only reports state and prints the command. Disabled: never enable; report and print the enable command (ruling 21). Not-installed or not-detectable: nothing runs; keep today's repo-copy path unchanged. Report update: ran|not-run, updateOk, updateDetail, matching QCLI-371's field names; a failed update keeps exit 0. Long timeout on the Codex upgrade (quest-cli measured >120s). Depends on the detection task.

acceptanceCriteria.text: With the plugin installed and --target naming the runtime, lore agents --force runs the scoped update (claude) or marketplace upgrade plus add (codex, with the all-opum-plugins notice) and reports update/updateOk/updateDetail
A bare lore agents --force, a disabled plugin, and a not-installed or not-detectable plugin run nothing and print the remedy; the repo-copy path is unchanged when the plugin is absent or undetectable
Tests drive the update path through a stub runtime binary on PATH, never the real claude/codex, and LORE_AGENT_PLUGINS=off runs nothing
